comments.comment: Pharmacist here! 👋 This is the bane of my existence, I override “warnings” on 90% of prescriptions (not just MHT). One of the huge downside to technologies and a litigious society.

The same exact thing happened to me when I ordered Veozah for a patient that was using vaginal estradiol. This info is outdated and I can’t wait till the black box warning is removed (🤞🏼) for vaginal estrogen!!!
Yes we can and we absolutely should be doing better than using outdated information 💯
